name: Gisa's colossal sea-beast
description: A giant crab-kraken-lobster horror raised by Gisa from the estuary bottom, later rebuilt by Geralf with the behemoth's legs.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
timeline.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
timeline.quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.
